metaDescription: Manage your Scale X referral link and track your recurring commissions.

accountsHelp: Attribution is final for the first account created from your link.
firstReferral: Your first referral appears here after they create their account.
commissionsHelp: Each row corresponds to a paid Stripe invoice.

codeHelp: 4 to 32 characters. It will be converted to uppercase in your link.
